（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
G.S.B. REGISTRY
No. D 5687
Date 10/1/34 Inspector）

January 10 34.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter dated January 5, 1934, on the subject
of Communist books ordered from Martin Lawrence,
London, by a person believed to be Madame Sun Yat-sen,
and to state that this information has been duly
passed to the Public Safety Bureau with a view to
having a watch kept by the local Postal Authorities
on all books which come from Martin Lawrence of London.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

for Officer i/c Special Branch.

H. N. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

1934年1月10日。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1934年1月5日来信，事由为据信系孙逸仙夫人之人向伦敦马丁·劳伦斯公司订购共产主义书籍一事；并告知该信息已正式转交公共安全局，以便由当地邮政当局对源自伦敦马丁·劳伦斯公司的所有书籍进行监控。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人

代特别分部主管

H. N. Steptoe 先生
英国驻沪总领事馆

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT    S.2, Special Branch.
Date January 9, 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
G. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No.
No. D 5607
Branch Political 1st）

Subject (in full) Communist literature despatched to Shanghai by
Messrs. Martin Lawrence, London.

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Everest

With reference to the attached letter dated
January 5, 1934, from H.B.M. Consulate-General on the
subject of communist literature despatched to persons
in Shanghai from Messrs. Martin Lawrence, London, I
have arranged with Supt. Tan Shao-liang that this
information be passed to the Postal Authorities through
the local Public Safety Bureau Headquarters.

D.I. Everest
D. I.

（批：Conf） Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 伦敦马丁·劳伦斯公司发往上海的共产主义文献。

编制及呈报人：警司 Everest

鉴于附上的英国驻沪总领事馆1934年1月5日来信，事由为伦敦马丁·劳伦斯公司向上海人士发送共产主义文献一事，本人已与谭绍良巡官商定，通过当地公共安全局总局将该信息转交邮政当局。

警司 Everest

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. R. REGISTRY.
No. D 5607
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.B. Date 6 / 1 34 SHANGHAI.
5th January, 1934.

My dear Givens,
I have received a report to the effect that the
the Ring-Verlag in Zurich (a Communist organisation which
runs a news agency and edits books) has communicated
with Martin Lawrence, Communist publishers in London,
asking them to send fifteen copies of the "Brown Book
of the Hitler Terror" to a person who is thought to be
Madame Sun Yat Sen. This person has been in communica-
tion with the Ring-Verlag, and states that she wants
credit facilities from Martin Lawrence for the actual
price of the books, but begs them to send copies of all
those which they bring out, and which they conceive may be
of use to her from a Communist point of view. It is
believed that any consignments sent on these terms will
care
be sent direct. You may/to warn the Bureau of Public
Safety to this effect, and get them to watch all consign-
ments of books which come through the Chinese P.O. and
emanating from Martin Lawrence of London.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

T. Givens Esq.,

（左侧手写批注：S 2 / JR）

英国驻沪总领事馆，
邮政信箱。 日期 34年1月6日 上海。
1934年1月5日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

我收到一份报告，称苏黎世的 Ring-Verlag（一个经营通讯社并编辑出版书籍的共产主义组织）已与伦敦的共产主义出版商马丁·劳伦斯公司联系，要求他们向一位据信为孙逸仙夫人的人士寄送十五本《希特勒恐怖布朗书》。此人与 Ring-Verlag 一直保持联系，并表示她希望马丁·劳伦斯公司就书籍实际价格提供赊账便利，但恳请他们寄送其出版的所有书籍副本，以及他们认为从共产主义角度看来对她有用的书籍。据信，按此条件发送的任何货物将直接寄出。你可/以就此警告公共安全局，并让他们监视所有经由中国邮政寄出、源自伦敦马丁·劳伦斯公司的书籍货物。

此致
敬礼

（签名）

T. Givens 先生，

（左侧手写批注：S 2 / JR）
